mobs.name: High Master Farwyn Nyxx
mobs.location:
Within the locked door in the Ratmen Garrison.
Requires Keying, key remains on your body on death.
mobs.description:
Little is known about the details of the fight. Below is based on observation and assumption.

Suggested Raid Size: 24 players (4 groups) with a minimum of: 3 tanks

Key Takeaway: Keep the raid on the balcony. Fight the important mobs on the balcony.

Fight Details:

The fight starts upon killing the trigger mob.
The main hallway spawns a bunch of red ghosts (20-50).
2 Drakes spawn ([[Malen`Kai]] and [[Dala`Nar]]) that have breath attacks, the breath attacks are Cone-based and hit for ~2000 damage (Dala`Nar is fire Based).
It is suggested to have 2 tanks split the drakes against each banner on the balcony and face them away from the raid.

mobs.name: A hill giant bandit
mobs.location: Giant Camp near Vale of Zintar
mobs.description: 4 giants spawn around the large campfire. 1 patrols through the valleys, 2 remain stationary, and one 1 patrols back to the Sangrel camp occasionally. Any of the 4 can spawn as a ranger, which can be seen by the mana bar. These frequently cast Twisting Roots and heal themselves for 60 damage per cast when below 50% health. They also buff themselves (and occasionally the other giants) with Diamondskin, SoW, a 15 point dmg shield, and corruption resistance; they also use Speed of the Predator when very low on health. The patrolling giants often fight canyon stalkers.
